answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Pledged actuary fellowship with actuarial profession attestation. It demands a fellowship the profession renews after valuation audits, and the violet is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the timber compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the opal for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
